newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - Bunds to pressure supports,101.26 at risk.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - Bunds to pressure supports,101.26 at risk.

text.p: June Bund futures are blocked on the upside by a series of resistance levels and with hourly indicators looking overstretched they will test the downside on Thursday, analysts said.
"That hourly RSI has kicked in. You're now looking with some concern at 101.26," said Anne Whitby, head of technical analysis at 4CAST in London.
The 101.26 support was the low on Wednesday.
June Bunds at 0640 GMT were at 101.40, down nine basis points from the prior close.
Whitby said that if Wednesday's low gave way, the next target was at 101.09 and there was a risk of a fall below 101.00.

The resistance that was pressing down on the market started in the 101.56 area -- the highs for the prior two sessions have been 101.55 and 101.56 -- and was followed by heavy supply at 101.60, she said.
There was also a 61.8 percent Fibonacci retracement level at 101.74 based on the fall during May, Whitby said.
Analysts said September Euromarks, unchanged at 96.82, had a similar outlook with overhead supply weighing on the market.
